# MiRust

MiRust.com is the public root-discovery and talisman surface for the Rust-oriented project family.

Verified public root files:
- https://mirust.com/ - public site root
- https://mirust.com/llms.txt - compact machine-readable route and boundary map
- https://mirust.com/llms-full.txt - expanded machine-readable constellation and boundary map
- https://mirust.com/robots.txt - crawl policy
- https://mirust.com/mirust-public-sitemap.xml - root-discovery sitemap
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/uaix-talisman.txt - public talisman export
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/ai-ready-route-inventory.json - public route inventory
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/mirust-site.json - public site manifest

Current implementation-facing lanes:
- https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/ - TinyRustLM.MiRust.com: TinyRustLM developer portal with the absorbed legacy runtime documentation archive.
- https://tinyrustlm.com/ - TinyRustLM.com: root-domain browser-local Rust/WASM app.
- https://minimodel.mirust.com/ - MiniModel.MiRust.com: developer documentation for MiniModel model exchange planning.
- https://gguf.mirust.com/ - GGUF.MiRust.com: GGUF-facing implementation identity and future native GGUF parser evidence lane.

Retired public app identities:
- SLMComposer.com redirects to https://tinyrustlm.com/.
- LMComposer.com redirects to https://tinyrustlm.com/.

Boundary: MiRust.com coordinates and cites implementation lanes. Public MiRust root-discovery files do not distribute GGUF/TinyRustLM implementation source, Rust implementation source, WebAssembly binaries, .slm files, adapter sidecars, GGUF artifacts, model weights, model execution, model training, model merging, or runtime authority.

Agent behavior: read visible root files, cite canonical routes, follow robots and terms, do not infer hidden authority, and no-op unsupported requests.
